note: Migration routes traced from the profile maps. Migrating, hunting and challenges are limited to active hours (server rule 1.4).

routes.name: Mixed Species Migration Route
routes.note: The big shared loop of the hadrosaur herds: from Tallbrush Coasts and Kelp Vale along the volcano coast, down through Stillwater Bog and Coastland Swamp to East Passage and Wollemi, back west over Hollow Hills and the Redwoods.

routes.name: Parasaurolophus Migration Route
routes.note: The Parasaurolophus' own northern loop (pink on its profile map); each herd keeps its own generational route.

routes.name: Ceratopsian Migration Route
routes.note: From the northern nesting canyon via Steep Run, Cedrus Forest and Cliff Edge Falls through the Redwoods and Hollow Hills to the Wollemi nesting grounds. Pachyrhinosaurus, Styracosaurus and Albertaceratops share it as a mixed ceratopsian herd.

routes.name: Eotriceratops Migration Route
routes.note: The matriarchies' route between their seasonal nesting grounds in the north and the south, along the western forests (Dry Fang Canyon, Black Fern Hills, Redwoods) with a branch over Cedrus Forest to Stillwater Bog. Psittacosaurus follow it too.

routes.name: Sauropod Migration Route
routes.note: The giants' corridors: the western route from Dry Fang Canyon over Steep Run and Cedrus Forest to Stillwater Bog and Cliff Edge Falls (Argentinosaurus and Amargasaurus use this part), and the Apatosaurus branch from Tallbrush Coasts over the Volcano Islands nursery to the Mudflats.

routes.name: Leedsichthys Migration Route
routes.note: The great sea loop through the north-eastern waters around the Coastal Bluffs, Palm Islands and Stonebed Shoal.

members.note: Tours the Leedsichthys loop peacefully outside its own sea territory (profile variant).
